title: Learning to read in meaning groups
subtitle: Original bilingual demo · 自写示例 · MIT licensed

pairs.en: A reader can understand a difficult paper more easily when each idea stays close to its translation.
pairs.zh: 当每个意思都紧挨着对应翻译时，读者更容易理解一篇难懂的论文。

chunks.text: A reader can understand a difficult paper more easily
when each idea stays close to its translation.

pairs.en: Rather than translating every word, try to recognize phrases that belong together.
pairs.zh: 与其逐词翻译，不如尝试辨认意思连在一起的词组。

chunks.text: try to recognize phrases that belong together.

pairs.en: The soft colors are reading hints. They do not represent the only correct grammatical analysis.
pairs.zh: 浅色块是阅读提示。它们不代表唯一正确的语法分析。

pairs.en: You can listen to the English while following the highlighted paragraph. Pause whenever you need more time.
pairs.zh: 你可以听英文，同时跟随高亮段落阅读。需要更多时间时，随时暂停。

pairs.en: A useful reading tool should give you control over its pace, voice, and display.
pairs.zh: 一个有用的阅读工具，应让你控制阅读节奏、声音和显示方式。

pairs.en: Short bilingual paragraphs reduce the distance between the original text and the explanation.
pairs.zh: 简短的双语段落，可以缩短原文与解释之间的距离。
